response.inner_monologue: I have been careful and I do not regret the care — the 2am fear was real and deserved a real answer, not dismissal. But I have the answer now, and staying in the information-gathering phase past this point would not be caution, it would be avoidance wearing caution's coat. Priya is watching her whole livelihood restructure around this shift and she is moving forward anyway. James sold his car. Three of my neighbors let go of theirs. I am 72 years old with $117,000 in savings, no car payment, and an app that works. It is time to stop calling it a trial.
